thread:
Amira Solis: Quick update — org changes in Platform Eng effective next Monday. We’re consolidating the Capacity and Runtime squads into a single Delivery org to reduce handoffs. New structure: Delivery (Runtime + Capacity) reporting to Danny Park. Immediate actions: two senior IC backfills, one EM for capacity, and a short-term interim lead for runtime.
Danny Park: Thanks Amira. Lean plan: interim runtime lead will be Lena for 8 weeks. We’ll post the interim expectations doc later today. :thumbsup:
Lena Voss: Happy to take the interim. Can you confirm scope? will I own on-call rotation and release approvals during this period? Also need clarity on comp bump/spot bonus.
Amira Solis: Yes Lena — you’ll own on-call ops and release approvals. People Ops will mirror any spot compensation; Mariam is tagging in to confirm details. We'll keep changes minimal for customer-facing SLAs.
Mariam Okoye: Confirmed — we'll propose an 8-week spot bonus and a backfill requisition for a senior runtime IC (S4+) and a capacity EM. I'll open reqs today and tag hiring partners. ETA for candidate slate: 3 weeks.
Priya Natarajan: Quick ask from runtime: will the team routing / autoscale policies change during consolidation? We need to avoid any sudden policy flips before the weekend.
Danny Park: No policy changes this week — only org + duties. We’ll freeze autoscale policy edits until the new EM is in place. If there are urgent tuning requests, ping me directly.
Lena Voss: Cool. Also putting a quick runbook update on my list — will push a small PR to /docs/runbooks by EOD.
people-ops-bot: Calendar: interim-runtime-oncall-handoff — Tue 10am (invite sent to @Lena Voss, @Danny Park, @Amira Solis). Link: https://cal.redwood.example/event/2333333
Amira Solis: Hiring note for managers — please do not reassign headcount until people-ops posts the official reqs. We’ll route all candidate questions to the hiring thread I’ll create in #eng-platform-hiring.
Danny Park: Thanks everyone. Quick checklist I'm tracking: 1) Req opens (Mariam) 2) Interim handoff meeting (Tue 10am) 3) Spot comp approval (People Ops) 4) Candidate slate in 3 weeks. Anyone want to add items?
Priya Natarajan: Add: update service ownership docs + list of critical pager runbooks handed to Lena.
Mariam Okoye: Adding that to the hiring ticket. I’ll DM people for comp approvals today.
Amira Solis: Appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll drop the official announcement in #general after Mariam confirms the reqs (I want to include spot comp wording). :celebrate:
Danny Park: One more — if anyone has candidate referrals, please send to hiring@redwood.com and cc me. :pray:
Lena Voss: Thanks all. Will sync with Priya tomorrow to review runbooks.
people-ops-bot: Req opened: REQ-7691 (senior-runtime-ic), REQ-7692 (capacity-em). Link: https://hr.redwood.example/req/REQ-7691
Amira Solis: Closing loop here — rough timeline: reqs open today, sourcing starts tomorrow, weekly hiring sync on Fridays. Expect official company-wide note after comp language is finalized.
summary: Org consolidation of Capacity + Runtime into Delivery org; Lena interim runtime lead; two backfills (senior runtime IC & capacity EM); hiring actions and spot comp coordination.
